interpretation: Discovery status alone does not prove content weakness. This snapshot starts the remediation program by route family; every weak page must be improved, intentionally noindexed, or consolidated rather than silently ignored.

initialRules.reason: Evergreen article routes are already protected by the repository article-readiness gate; the immediate issue is crawl demand, not automatic thin-content removal.
initialRules.remediation: Keep indexable, reinforce relevant hub/county/destination links, and refresh sources/content when freshness checks show drift.

initialRules.reason: County pages are cornerstone TexasDefined geography pages.
initialRules.remediation: Verify county-specific data completeness and strengthen discovery from statewide county, destination, event, golf, RV, wedding and food layers.

initialRules.reason: Destination pages are core Explore entities with an existing destination readiness audit.
initialRules.remediation: Keep indexable only when the destination audit passes; reinforce internal links, official-source freshness, imagery and county/nearby relationships.

initialRules.reason: Author pages support trust and E-E-A-T but need substantive bios and genuine article relationships to deserve independent indexation.
initialRules.remediation: Verify profile depth, expertise, byline archive, photo/organization data and internal links; use noindex until the author page earns standalone search value if necessary.

initialRules.reason: Event pages have legitimate search intent but depend on current official dates, venue and status.
initialRules.remediation: Refresh from official sources, confirm future occurrence/date confidence, enrich location/FAQ/related-place links and retain indexability only while current.

initialRules.reason: State-comparison pages are useful but programmatic families can become repetitive or thin.
initialRules.remediation: Add state-specific data, unique narrative comparisons, sources, decision-useful tables, FAQs and reciprocal links; consolidate pages without distinct search intent.

initialRules.reason: County-specific property-tax pages are high-value but generated pages must contain county-specific substance.
initialRules.remediation: Verify current tax/appraisal data, county-specific explanation, source freshness, calculator/context links and unique FAQs before full index promotion.

initialRules.reason: Individual venue pages should rank independently only when they provide meaningful venue-specific planning information.
initialRules.remediation: Add verified official source, location, teams/events, parking/access, nearby travel context, images and county/city relationships; noindex until the entity gate passes if needed.

initialRules.reason: Access, boating, guide and nearby lake subpages can become thin fragments of the parent lake guide.
initialRules.remediation: Add lake-specific details, official TPWD/agency sources, maps/relationships and enough unique content; otherwise consolidate into the parent lake page.

initialRules.reason: Nested people, symbols, techniques, routes, heritage, preservation and guide pages need genuine standalone historical, architectural or planning value.
initialRules.remediation: Verify unique sourced narrative, image rights, entity relationships, reciprocal hub links and standalone intent; consolidate thin support nodes into the appropriate hub.

initialRules.reason: These pages belong to established topical, Explore, data, fishing, collection or top-level authority systems.
initialRules.remediation: Keep indexable when their existing route/template gates pass; strengthen crawl demand, freshness and internal discovery rather than noindexing by default.

explicitReviewedOverrides.reason: Time-stamped live/news-style slug does not belong in the evergreen article namespace.
explicitReviewedOverrides.remediation: Confirm the surviving canonical article/news URL and 301 to it; if no replacement exists, remove cleanly after internal-link cleanup.

nextPhase.rule: Repeat the same KEEP / IMPROVE / NOINDEX / REMOVE_CONSOLIDATE review across all public route registries and dynamic URL families, then keep the process recurring every 30 days.
nextPhase.doNotDo: Do not bulk noindex or delete pages merely because GSC has not crawled them.
